rls.capability_tables: RLS enabled; no DML grants to capability roles; service_role SELECT only on the new tables

revocation.session: revoke_session sets principal_sessions.revoked_at; subsequent bound RPCs raise mip_authz_revoked_session immediately
revocation.binding: revoke_binding sets runtime_bindings.revoked_at; subsequent bound RPCs raise mip_authz_revoked_principal
revocation.catalog: missing GRANT remains PostgreSQL permission denied, not an mip_authz_* code
revocation.ambient: service_role complete() ignores session revocation — that is the application vs runtime distinction

unresolved_live_bindings: Isolated roles are not production runtime-to-principal bindings. See runtime-permission-proposal.json.
